worldcombat.skill.forcepalm.summary: Press out along the aim, step in and plant your palm on the target, driving a shock wave through its body: attack decides how hard the palm lands and the vibration may leave it paralysed. The through form lets the wave leave the real contact point and strike a second foe on the line behind.
worldcombat.skill.forcepalm.use.0: Press a palm in at contact and settle by attack
worldcombat.skill.forcepalm.use.1: Leave a close foe paralysed with the shock
worldcombat.skill.forcepalm.use.2: Through form: catch a second foe on the line behind
The palm deals %1$s contact physical damage with a %2$s block hit radius.
It presses in within about %1$s blocks, stepping up to %4$s blocks to close the gap; the struck target has a %2$s chance to be paralysed and is shoved %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.forcepalm.through.on: Through form: after the main hit lands, the wave travels %2$s blocks from the real contact point, dealing %1$s physical damage to each further target in the narrow line (up to %3$s more).
worldcombat.skill.forcepalm.through.off: Focus form: the force stays on the target, heavier and more likely to numb; turning through on reaches the foe behind at the cost of a lighter main hit.
worldcombat.skill.forcepalm.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, cost %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.forcepalm.growth.0: From level %1$s the palm power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.forcepalm.growth.1: From level %1$s the palm power rises to %2$s and the numb chance to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.forcepalm.preference.t: On: after the main hit lands, the wave leaves the real contact point and strikes up to two more foes in the narrow line behind (the main hit is a little lighter, the numb chance lower and the cooldown longer). Off (focus form, default): the force stays on one target, heavier and more likely to numb.
worldcombat.skill.forcepalm.preference.a: Beyond this distance it closes in before pressing. Larger values commit to the charge from further out.
On: prefer it while the target is not yet paralysed (save this palm's chance for someone who can still be numbed). Off: only the threat itself counts.
Paralysis lasts about 40 seconds: movement speed is halved, and every move or ordinary attack has a 25% chance to fail; Electric-type targets cannot be paralysed.
